title: Federal student loan deferment and forbearance
facts: Deferment and forbearance can temporarily postpone or reduce federal student loan payments when eligibility requirements are met.
Interest consequences differ by loan type and relief type; borrowers should not assume interest stops during every deferment or forbearance.
These options do not erase the debt and can affect total repayment cost and progress toward some forgiveness programs.
Borrowers should use their federal loan servicer and StudentAid.gov to determine eligibility and alternatives.
